columns.name: OTP
columns.definition: On-time performance for this flight, against schedule. SIGNED — negative is early, positive is late. The unit is SECONDS, not minutes: every one of the 301 values profiled is a whole multiple of 60, as are both extremes, which a minute-granular column would not be (TAT, a real minutes column, takes values like 9, 11 and 23). Divide by 60 before showing minutes. Observed range is roughly -90,720 to 253,860 — about -25 to +70 hours — so the extremes are data-quality outliers rather than real delays.
